title: Performance engine lock assumed a 2.1 official module during an exact 2.0 campaign

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.5 archive on trusted Factorio 2.0.77 under compact, provenance-bound staging
source_observation.fact: After the historical package-source authority was accepted, the runner tried to hash data\recycler even though the governed 2.0 campaign declares only elevated-rails, quality, and space-age. Factorio 2.0.77 does not contain data\recycler, so proof stopped before Factorio launch.

reproducer.expected: The official-data lock consists of core, base, and exactly the official modules declared by the governed campaign; a declared missing module fails before Factorio launch.
reproducer.observed: The runner hard-coded recycler into every lock and failed with 'Performance authority is absent: ...\data\recycler'.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; exact-engine official-data lock construction only

admission.reason: The defect is a pre-launch assurance lock error. The correction narrows the lock to the governed engine/module contract and cannot change a package.

closure.evidence: The runner derives its official-data roots from governed campaign declarations, records them with the lock digest, and rejects declared unavailable modules; exact 2.0 and 2.1 performance proofs plus hosted exact-head proof remain required.
